title: Ubugingo bwa Mbere bwahagaze
intro: Kera cyane mbere yuko intumwa iyo ari yo yose ibaho ku isi, mbere yuko ibyanditswe byera bihishurwa, habayeho ikiremwa kidasanzwe. Ubu bugingo bwaremwe n'amaboko y'Imana, buhabwa ahantu h'ubwiza budasanzwe, kandi bwageragejwe mu buryo bwashoboraga kugaragara mu mateka yose y'abantu. Icyakurikiyeho ni inkuru y'intege nke, ukwihana kw'ukuri, n'iherezo ryahinduraga inzira y'irema burundu. Ushobora kwiyumvisha uwo ari we?
clues: Naremwe n'amaboko y'Imbabazi nyinshi mu mukungugu wo hasi
Nahawe urugo rwiza rudasanzwe, aho nta nzara cyangwa umunaniro byashoboraga kunkoraho
Nategetswe kutigera negera igiti na kimwe, kuko cyari kibujijwe
Jye na mugenzi wanjye twarashutswe maze twegera igiti cyabujijwe, tunyuranyije n'itegeko ry'Umwami wacu
Twasubiye ku Mwami wacu twihannye by'ukuri, kandi tubabarirwa ibyaha byacu
Abantu bose baturutse kuri twe; ndi uwa mbere wanyuze kuri iyi si

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yoherejwe ku isi nk'umurinzi wa mbere w'ikiremwamuntu
Farawo n'ingabo ze barohamye mu nyanja
Yahawe ububasha ku bwami bwa Egiputa
outcome.answer: Yoherejwe ku isi nk'umurinzi wa mbere w'ikiremwamuntu

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
